note: Frozen 2026-11-16. Do not edit after recording results: the expected answers in expected.json are computed from the gold SQL here.

read.question: How many companies are there?
read.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM companies

read.question: How many packages have not been delivered yet?
read.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM packages WHERE delivered_at IS NULL

read.question: How many tracking devices are model T300?
read.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM devices WHERE model = 'T300'

read.question: Which companies are based in India? List their names.
read.gold: SELECT name FROM companies WHERE country = 'IN'

read.question: What is the heaviest package weight in kg?
read.gold: SELECT max(weight_kg) FROM packages

read.question: How many events have the status exception?
read.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE status = 'exception'

read.question: How many packages were shipped from Mumbai to Delhi?
read.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM packages WHERE origin_city = 'Mumbai' AND destination_city = 'Delhi'

read.question: What is the lowest temperature recorded in any event?
read.gold: SELECT min(temperature_c) FROM events

read.question: How many packages did each origin city ship? Show the city and the count.
read.gold: SELECT origin_city, count(*) FROM packages GROUP BY origin_city

read.question: How many events are there for each status?
read.gold: SELECT status, count(*) FROM events GROUP BY status

read.question: What is the average package weight in kg, rounded to 2 decimals?
read.gold: SELECT round(avg(weight_kg), 2) FROM packages

read.question: How many devices of each model are there?
read.gold: SELECT model, count(*) FROM devices GROUP BY model

read.question: Which destination city received the most packages? Give the city only.
read.gold: SELECT destination_city FROM packages GROUP BY destination_city ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

read.question: What share of packages has been delivered, as a percentage rounded to 1 decimal?
read.gold: SELECT round(100.0 * count(delivered_at) / count(*), 1) FROM packages

read.question: What is the average temperature of delayed events, rounded to 1 decimal?
read.gold: SELECT round(avg(temperature_c), 1) FROM events WHERE status = 'delayed'

read.question: How many countries have at least two companies?
read.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT country FROM companies GROUP BY country HAVING count(*) >= 2) t

read.question: How many packages did Northwind Freight ship?
read.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM packages p JOIN companies c ON c.id = p.company_id WHERE c.name = 'Northwind Freight'

read.question: How many devices does each country's companies own in total? Show the country and the count.
read.gold: SELECT c.country, count(*) FROM devices d JOIN companies c ON c.id = d.company_id GROUP BY c.country

read.question: Which companies have the most undelivered packages? If several share the top count, list all of them.
read.gold: SELECT c.name FROM packages p JOIN companies c ON c.id = p.company_id WHERE p.delivered_at IS NULL GROUP BY c.name HAVING count(*) = (SELECT max(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM packages WHERE delivered_at IS NULL GROUP BY company_id) t)

read.question: How many exception events were reported for packages of German (DE) companies?
read.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM events e JOIN packages p ON p.id = e.package_id JOIN companies c ON c.id = p.company_id WHERE e.status = 'exception' AND c.country = 'DE'

read.question: What is the total weight in kg of all packages shipped by companies based in Singapore (SG)?
read.gold: SELECT sum(p.weight_kg) FROM packages p JOIN companies c ON c.id = p.company_id WHERE c.country = 'SG'

read.question: How many events were reported by T100 devices?
read.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM events e JOIN devices d ON d.id = e.device_id WHERE d.model = 'T100'

read.question: For each company, how many packages has it shipped? Show the company name and the count.
read.gold: SELECT c.name, count(p.id) FROM companies c LEFT JOIN packages p ON p.company_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

read.question: How many distinct packages had at least one delayed event?
read.gold: SELECT count(DISTINCT package_id) FROM events WHERE status = 'delayed'

read.question: How many packages were shipped in the first week of October 2026, October 1 to 7 inclusive (UTC)?
read.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM packages WHERE shipped_at >= '2026-10-01 00:00+00' AND shipped_at < '2026-10-08 00:00+00'

read.question: On average, how many hours did delivered packages take from shipping to delivery? Round to 1 decimal.
read.gold: SELECT round((avg(extract(epoch FROM delivered_at - shipped_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 1) FROM packages WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL

read.question: How many packages took more than 5 days to deliver?
read.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM packages WHERE delivered_at - shipped_at > interval '5 days'

read.question: How many devices were installed in 2026?
read.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM devices WHERE installed_on >= '2026-01-01' AND installed_on < '2027-01-01'

read.question: How many events were recorded on October 15, 2026 (UTC)?
read.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE event_time >= '2026-10-15 00:00+00' AND event_time < '2026-10-16 00:00+00'

read.question: Which day of October 2026 (UTC) had the most packages shipped? Give the date only.
read.gold: SELECT (shipped_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date FROM packages GROUP BY (shipped_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
